name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

models.description:
Which {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s to monitor. If specified, it will take precedence over
{@link #modelFilter} or the {@link #assetFilter} + {@link #statusLabels} combination.

evaluationSpec.description: The {@link MlModel.Evaluation.Spec} that should be used for model evaluation.

modelFilter.description:
Specify a filter for which {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s to monitor. If specified, it will take precedence over
the {@link #assetFilter} + {@link #statusLabels} combination

assetFilter.description:
Use this field along with the {@link #statusLabels} field do directly define the {@link ReliabilityAsset}s whose models
should be monitored, as well as the deployment status of the models that should be monitored for each asset. By default,
the default combination will monitor the `CHAMPION` models for the assets that have their `sensorRelations` field populated.

statusLabels.description:
Specify a filter on the deployment status of the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s that should be monitored, for the assets
that correspond to the provided {@link #assetFilter}.

spec.description: The {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel.MonitoringScoreSpec} that should be used for model monitoring.

title: A {@link Spec} to orchestrate a model monitoring Workflow on {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.ModelMonitoring
